d:
Relive the timeless romance of the 90s with “Chand Taare” from the superhit Bollywood movie Yes Boss, starring Shah Rukh Khan & Juhi Chawla.
Enjoy this evergreen romantic song in stunning 4K Ultra HD and revisit the magic of 90s Bollywood music.
Song: Chand Taare
Movie: Yes Boss
Cast: Shah Rukh Khan, Juhi Chawla
Singer: Abhijeet
Music: Jatin-Lalit
Lyrics: Javed Akhtar
